visual_description: A long-handled net or scoop, approximately 4 feet in length. It features a lightweight, yet durable, anodized aluminum pole with a comfortable, textured rubber grip near the top. The net itself is a deep, sturdy mesh bag made of robust, quick-drying synthetic fabric, attached to a strong, circular metal frame (approx. 10-inch diameter). The mesh is a dark, neutral color, showing minor wear and a few faint water stains, suggesting use in collecting aquatic samples or scooping sediment.

constraints.texture: Smooth, slightly metallic sheen on aluminum pole; textured rubber grip; interwoven fabric mesh texture; subtle water stains and wear on net.
